name: Anardana Chicken
ingredients: 3 tablespoons dried pomegranate seeds (anardana), ground into a coarse powder
2-3 cloves, 1 black cardamom, and 1 cinnamon stick
instructions: 1. Heat mustard oil in a heavy-bottomed pan until smoking, then reduce heat and add whole spices (cloves, cardamom, cinnamon) and cumin.
2. Add the chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
3. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw aroma disappears.
4. Add turmeric, chili powder, and coriander powder, followed by the chicken pieces.
5. Sauté the chicken on high heat for 5-7 minutes to sear.
6. Whisk the yogurt with the ground anardana powder and add this mixture to the pan.
7. Add salt, cover, and simmer on low heat until the chicken is tender and the oil separates from the masala.
8. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with steamed rice or siddu.
description: Anardana Chicken is a quintessential Himachali dish that highlights the region's reliance on dried fruits and seeds to provide tanginess in the absence of tomatoes. The use of dried pomegranate seeds gives the curry a unique tart profile, deeply rooted in the culinary traditions of the mountain communities.
